race.comment: KIWI HANK (1) was strongly supported last start when a short priced favourite and duly saluted winning by half a length at this track in a handy 26.17. Draws the cherry and has the ability and in winning form. Looks a key chance if runs up to latest figure. CHOOSE YOU (2) stalked the lead from the inside draw before finishing second last start (26.12) at this track in Grade 6 over 461m. Didn't win last time but still ran one of the quickest times on the card. Winning chance. NIGHT NIGHT (3) is yet to break through in six starts but has run a number of placings. Was below best latest when fifth (19.96) at this track but did hit the frame the start prior. The form out of last race has been strong. Has ability and can atone. GREG'S BOY (4) comes into calculations after placing most recently.
